metaTitle: Custom Heat Transfer Seat Cushions | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom heat transfer seat cushions for offices, events, or safety programs. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Heat transfer decoration on seat cushions delivers vibrant, full-color logos and detailed artwork that won't peel or fade over time. This method is ideal for large corporate orders where consistency across every cushion matters. Whether you're outfitting an office ergonomics program or distributing seat cushions at a trade show, heat transfer provides a smooth, durable finish that stands up to daily use. Choose from foam, gel, or memory foam styles to match your comfort needs.
heroAltText: Stack of custom heat transfer seat cushions with full-color logo decoration, ideal for office or event bulk orders
